items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the five trumpets was Thad Jones, me, Wendell Cully

ctx.x: No, you‘re talking about the last band with Count Basie.
Yeah, Count Basie…the five trumpets was Thad Jones, me, Wendell Cully passed so they got…who did they get in place of him? They didn‘t have five trumpets.
